content.rationale: structured requirements with a runnable artifact dependent: conformance is what running the artifact shows, so the gate states the observables the requirements demand and leaves the verdict to the run; twslmwvn names an empty-state message without pinning its text, and rmsyvtvn names the persisted fields without pinning the values an implausible stored state falls back to, so the check is deliberately structural there: it asserts that the canvas shows a message rather than staying blank and the shape of what is read back, and asserts no message text or fallback value
